_readme: Edit this file to change the Clients tab. Every entry needs name; version, date, manifestId, notes, uploadedAt, status and files are optional. status is one of: ready, partial, broken, archived. File paths are relative to the site root, so they start with downloads/ (or use a full https:// URL for GitHub Releases). Run .\scripts\add-file.ps1 downloads\your-build.zip to generate size + sha256 automatically.

entries.notes: Winter Wonderland '16 is live: accounts without Steam, pen shapes, a tree, a present that opens, and voice. Be excellent to each other!
